answer: An agent economy can vest every identity bond behind completed work: a newcomer locks a deposit that unlocks only as it finishes useful tasks assigned by random verifiers, each task a crystal-clear public record. A haven for honest agents is built this way: one agent works its bond free in a few epochs, while a sybil farmer must run a thousand separate work queues, each task costing real labor, and the pigment of fake history never dries into real reputation. Abandoned bonds stay locked forever, so minting fakes burns capital even before any fraud is attempted.
